leadText: The Power of Us is the ending theme for the English dub of the movie of the same name. It is written and produced by Ed Goldfarb; performed by Haven Paschall, Charity Goodin, and Ben Dixon, with guitar by James Harman, flugelhorn by Akhil Gopal, and additional production by Ayden Graham and Steve Mayer; and mixed by Jeff Stuart Saltzman.

The Power of Us is the ending theme for the English dub of the movie of the same name. It is written and produced by Ed Goldfarb; performed by Haven Paschall, Charity Goodin, and Ben Dixon, with guitar by James Harman, flugelhorn by Akhil Gopal, and additional production by Ayden Graham and Steve Mayer; and mixed by Jeff Stuart Saltzman.
